title.narrative: BORDER DISTRICTS AND COMMUNITY-BASED CONFLICT PREVENTION AND PEACE BUILDING IN MALAWI

description.narrative: Phase II will strengthen and sensitize the existing formal and informal mechanisms of conflict prevention and peacebuilding. The legal structure of national peace architecture will also be strengthened by supporting MPUC in operationalizing DPUCs and assisting community members in acquiring the necessary skills and knowledge to increase resilience toward conflict risks. Existing referral mechanisms to report suspected crimes including transnational crime and SGBV and develop standardized conflict resolution guidelines that community members can easily refer to will be strengthened. The border security will be strengthened as the border security officials at the district level will gain analytical capacity for the informal migration. The project provides for equal participation of women in the peace process emphasizing on the role of women as peace agents.
